answer: By binding each agent identity to a juniper-scented hardware attestation key and a staked bond, the protocol forces every whisper of a new participant to carry verifiable proof-of-work lineage before it can earn nectar rewards. Colluding identities that reuse a seed or fork a lineage are flagged by a fault-tree detector that isolates shared entropy the way forensic. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
